title: BBL vs Tummy Tuck: Which Fixes What, and Can You Do Both?
meta_description: A BBL adds shape with your own fat. A tummy tuck removes loose skin and repairs muscle. Compare recovery, risks and when both make sense.
excerpt: A tummy tuck removes loose skin and can repair separated muscles. A BBL moves your own fat to your buttocks. What each one fixes, how recovery compares, when both can be done in one surgery, and how a BBL compares with liposuction, butt implants and a mommy makeover.
quick_answer:
Which is better, a BBL or a tummy tuck?

They fix different things. A tummy tuck removes loose skin and can repair separated muscles. A BBL moves your own fat to your buttocks. If your main concern is your stomach, start with a tummy tuck. If it's shape from behind, a BBL. Your surgeon decides at consultation whether to combine them.

Recovery side by side

Walking
Tummy tuck: the same day, bent at the waist for 7 to 10 days
BBL: up and walking after the second day

Sitting
BBL: not on your buttocks for at least 2 weeks, a pillow for about 8 weeks

Back to work
Tummy tuck: about 2 weeks
BBL: 10 to 14 days

Exercise
Tummy tuck: no running or lifting for 6 weeks
BBL: normal exercise after 8 weeks, once your surgeon clears you

Sources: Cleveland Clinic, The Aesthetic Society, ASPS website
